meta.title: Who Is in the Photo? — offline face identification

components.label: Browser page
components.explanation: Step 1 uses <input webkitdirectory> to upload every file in the chosen folder (only the file name is sent, not the sub-folder path). Step 2 uploads one group photo. No external scripts, fonts or CDNs are loaded.

components.label: Results view
components.explanation: Draws the group photo on a <canvas>, then a green box for identified faces or an orange box for Unknown, numbered left to right, plus a table of number, name and similarity score.

components.label: FastAPI server
components.explanation: POST /api/gallery builds and replaces the gallery (rejected if no usable faces; previous gallery kept). POST /api/identify decodes the photo and returns boxes, names and scores. GET /api/status reports the loaded people. Limits: 15 MB per image, 500 gallery images.

components.label: In-memory gallery
components.explanation: app.state.gallery holds a list of GalleryEntry(name, filename, 512-d embedding). Nothing is written to disk.

components.label: FaceEngine
components.explanation: build_gallery: name from file name (trailing numbers removed), decode, detect; 0 faces -> retry with 25% border, then skip with warning; several faces -> largest face used with a warning. identify: detect faces, call match_faces, number faces left to right.

components.label: InsightFace FaceAnalysis
components.explanation: Loaded once at startup with allowed_modules detection + recognition, CPUExecutionProvider, det_size 640x640. Returns boxes, detection scores and L2-normalised 512-d embeddings.

components.label: match_faces
components.explanation: Cosine similarity of every face against every reference photo; each person's score is the max over their photos; a name is given only at or above the threshold (default 0.40, not calibrated); greedy one-to-one assignment, strongest pairs first, so one name is never used for two faces.

components.label: buffalo_l model files
components.explanation: Local ONNX files: det_10g.onnx (SCRFD detector) and w600k_r50.onnx (ArcFace ResNet-50 recogniser), plus three unused modules. Not committed; licensed for non-commercial research use.

components.label: InsightFace release
components.explanation: scripts/download_model.py calls FaceEngine.load(); InsightFace downloads buffalo_l.zip only if the files are missing. This is the only network access in the project and happens during setup, not at runtime.

boundaries.label: Your laptop (no internet needed after setup; not yet tested with Wi-Fi off)

cards.title: Recognition flow
items: Folder upload -> one ArcFace embedding per reference photo, named from the file name
Group photo -> SCRFD finds every face -> embeddings
Cosine similarity, best photo per person, threshold 0.40 (not calibrated)
Greedy one-to-one assignment; everything else is Unknown

cards.title: Known limits
items: Gallery lives in memory and is shared by all browser tabs
A multi-face reference photo uses its largest face (warning only)

cards.title: Offline status
items: No external URLs in the page; no cloud APIs in the code
Model download happens only in setup
